explanation: The nonce check in verify must stay: rejecting a token whose nonce is in seen prevents replay attacks. #123 is the related issue.
Call ensure_key_salt before constructing KeyManager. If salt setup fails, startup must stop.
Before allocating buf, topN must be no greater than maxSimpleTopN so the resulting slice stays at or below 1 MiB.
If meta.abi_version is missing, the mapping must produce None. Treating it as the current ABI would be dangerous. #1784 is the related issue.
The external TLP configuration file /etc/tlp.conf is read after files matching /etc/tlp.d/*.conf, so its settings can override values written to the drop-in at /etc/tlp.d/90-power.conf.
These TLP settings require version 1.10 or later. _AC, _BAT and _SAV are profile suffixes. Leaving the _AC setting unset preserves GNOME’s Performance toggle; this command sets only the _BAT setting.
unsure: The comment does not define what the _SAV profile represents.

explanation: On a JSON parse error, this catch block deliberately returns null; its caller is responsible for logging the warning.
When AllowedTools is set, remove --dangerously-skip-permissions from the arguments because that flag bypasses --allowedTools. The comment applies to RemoveSkipPermissions.

For the meaning of this function’s dead-code verdicts, consult the verdict table associated with is_definitely_dead_code in rust/xray-core/src/compiler/graph_preamble.rs. The path identifies a file and the name after the colon identifies a symbol.
Replace the fixed repos_skipped value with a count derived from the domains-to-repos mapping. #874 tracks that work.
index.regex_query uses a linear-time DFA and does not backtrack; the comment records the performance behavior of this query.

Keep this token-family table schema coordinated with RefreshTokenSqliteBackend._ensure_schema in src/storage/refresh_token_backend.py. The path identifies the file and the name after the colon identifies the class method.
The vendor batch API accepts at most 500 items, which is why MAX_BATCH is 500. doc:vendor-api#limits points to the limits anchor in the vendor API documentation.
Keep these Status values coordinated with STATUS_LABELS in web/src/status.ts. Reordering the iota constants changes the meanings of already stored integer values. #88 is the related issue.
The index must put tenant_id before created_at to match the orders_by_tenant query. That ordering applies to the CREATE INDEX statement.
unsure: The comment names orders_by_tenant but gives no file path, so its exact location is unspecified.

explanation: TList.Add must maintain FCount at or below Length(FItems); Grow preserves that bound when the item storage expands.
Call _flush before closing the sink because closing drops _buf. The order in close prevents buffered data from being lost.

A path supplied by a request must be resolved under workspaceRoot, and paths containing .. that escape that root must be rejected. The shown line resolves and normalizes userPath; the comment also requires an escape check.
Drain the ring before freeing buf. Freeing buf first could let the interrupt handler use freed memory. #2201 is the related issue.

Reserve space for n items up front to use one allocation; repeated push_back growth accounted for 40% of the measured profile. doc:perf-notes#ingest points to the ingest anchor in the performance notes.
Use HOLDLOCK on this SQL Server MERGE because concurrent upserts can race without it. doc:mssql-merge#concurrency points to the concurrency anchor in the MERGE documentation.
The autonomous transaction is deliberate: it lets the audit row survive even if the caller rolls back its transaction. The comment applies to the PRAGMA.

SQLite ALTER TABLE cannot drop the needed constraints, so this migration rebuilds the table, starting with leases_new. doc:sqlite-alter#otheralter points to the relevant SQLite ALTER documentation anchor.
The loop polls every five seconds because NFS mounts do not emit the inotify events this code would need. That explains the wait(5) interval.
Keep the awaited jobs in a for...of loop. Awaiting inside forEach would let errors escape the intended try/catch.
Every decoded Vec<u8> frame must have length at most MAX_FRAME; the decoder rejects larger frames. The comment applies to the value returned by read_frame.
Register the shutdown hook before starting the pool. The hook drains the pool when the process receives SIGTERM.
Move the fixed retry delay into configuration. The task is complete when Default in internal/retry/policy.go reads that configuration; the path identifies the file and Default is the named symbol.
Issue #412 contains the full matrix of transitions among the LeaseState values Active, Released and Stale.
Pass the token through standard input, never as a command-line argument. Other users can see arguments through ps; --token-stdin avoids putting the token there.
Create app_reader before granting it SELECT access. Migration 042 assumes that role already exists.

Stripe may retry a webhook for three days, so on_event must handle repeated delivery without duplicating its effect. doc:stripe#webhook-retries points to the webhook-retries anchor in the Stripe documentation.
Compare the MACs using hmac.Equal because it runs in constant time; using == would reveal timing information. The comment applies to the signature check.
Build CodeGraph once per index, at a cost proportional to the number of edges. Do not rebuild it for each query.
Changing the packed TCustomerRec layout would make saved .dat files incompatible. Bump FILE_VERSION if the layout changes.
Change MSG_MAX and MSG_MAX_WIRE together. MSG_MAX_WIRE is the symbol in proto/messages.h that is coupled to this definition.
After authMiddleware runs, session.userId must be non-null when handler executes.
The synchronized block is deliberate because the cache’s check-then-put operation must be atomic. The comment explains the choice of synchronization over ConcurrentHashMap.
Because the repository alias comes from a user, validate it against the registry before joining it into a path. #1996 is the related security issue.
Payment Amount must be nonnegative. A refund is represented as a separate row with Kind = 'R', rather than by inserting a negative amount.
Set the stop flag before joining the worker. Otherwise the worker may keep running and join may block forever.

GitHub’s API limit is 5,000 requests per hour per token; the limiter is configured around that external limit. doc:github-rest#rate-limits points to the rate-limits anchor in the GitHub REST documentation.
Stop the cidx service before replacing its binary. Replacing the binary while it is running can fail with “Text file busy.”
Sharing _lease across jobs can expose one user’s credentials to another. #77 is the related issue.
The ids passed to this DELETE must contain no more than 999 values because the comment treats 999 as SQLite’s bound-variable limit for one statement.
If cgroup.create fails, log a warning and let the job continue. This deliberately tolerates a bad memory estimate instead of aborting the job.
Remove the legacy /v1/jobs route. #530 tracks that work.
The session model decision, including why sessions are per tab, is documented at the session-model anchor in doc:adr-007. The comment applies to SessionRegistry.
This partial index covers only rows where released_at is NULL and made active-lease lookups 30 times faster. The WHERE clause is the condition that makes the index partial.

Keep EVENT_TYPES coordinated with EVENT_LABELS in web/src/events.ts and with docs/events.md. The path and symbol reference identify the web labels; the second path identifies the events documentation.
